links.outcome: External validation of S-PATH on local hospital data versus MSBOS baseline (AUROC, type and screen recommendation rate)
links.effect: Median S-PATH AUROC 0.929 vs MSBOS 0.857; S-PATH recommended type and screen for 32.5% vs 51.6% of cases at equal sensitivity (17.9 percentage point median difference)
links.quote: The median (IQR) S-PATH AUROC was 0.929 (0.915-0.946), whereas the median (IQR) MSBOS AUROC was 0.857 (0.822-0.884).

links.outcome: Performance evaluated separately at each of 45 hospitals
links.effect: S-PATH outperformed MSBOS across hospitals; median AUROC 0.929 (IQR 0.915-0.946), showing external validity and discrimination
links.quote: Performance was evaluated at each hospital separately.

links.outcome: Comparison of S-PATH against standard-of-care MSBOS baseline on same data
links.effect: S-PATH recommended type and screens for median 32.5% vs 51.6% of cases at the same sensitivity; AUROC 0.929 vs 0.857
links.quote: S-PATH was consistently more effective than standard care, suggesting its potential for use as a perioperative clinical decision support tool.

screen.reason: The study conducts a large-scale external validation of an existing predictive algorithm (S-PATH) across 45 diverse hospitals without local retraining, testing whether it maintains discrimination and performance compared to standard care.
